info.title: Flame in Freefall active backend contract
info.description: Active implementation contract. The historical S0 contract and pinned schemas remain separate. Range filters use accepted inclusive overlap (#33); comparisons require matching known categorical conditions and hardware (#34). Scientific review remains explicit on unchanged prepared records.

get.description: Unknown or repeated query parameters return 400. Validate parameters before dataset availability and resource existence. Success responses preserve prepared records. Coverage counts distinct source run records after duplicate handling. Known matching categorical conditions and hardware form comparison groups; unknowns are indeterminate. Pending review or unknown conditions prevents a not_in_PSI assertion. Region bounds represent the request, not inferred bins. Scope is the saved PSI snapshot.
